name: ngram-type
title: Ngram Type
description: Guided n-gram typing practice for Raycast: bigrams through English Core, optional phrase transfer, Focus error bank, and WPM/accuracy drills.
author: imbrian

commands.name: practice
commands.title: Practice Ngrams
commands.description: Train typing speed and accuracy with guided n-grams, English Core, and optional phrases

scripts.build:data: node scripts/build-english-core.mjs && node scripts/generate-english-phrases.mjs && node scripts/build-english-phrases.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check:data && tsc --outDir test-dist --declaration false --sourceMap false && node --test test-dist/test/*.test.js

preferences.name: defaultMode
preferences.title: Default mode
preferences.description: Cold-start practice mode when no saved progress exists.

preferences.name: soundEnabled
preferences.title: Sound effects
preferences.label: Enable sounds by default
preferences.description: Play keystroke and feedback sounds on cold start (Settings still toggles per session).

preferences.name: defaultMinWPM
preferences.title: Default minimum WPM
preferences.description: Free-practice minimum WPM applied on cold start (guided lessons keep their own thresholds).
